Entry.JapaneseText: ありました。 これがジャックシードの アクセスパスです
Entry.EnglishText: We're here. Take the access pass.

Entry.JapaneseText: リチア、肝心の転送エネルギーは どうやって調達するの？
Entry.EnglishText: Lithia, where do you plan on getting the energy for the transfer?
Well...

Entry.JapaneseText: ぎゃあっ！ ク、クロアセラフ〜っ!?
Entry.EnglishText: EEK! Chlorseraph~?!

Entry.JapaneseText: 認識ミスだ、<Beryl>。 こいつはクロアセラフの兄弟機 クリノセラフだ
Entry.EnglishText: Incorrectly idendified, Beryl. This is Chlorseraph's brother, Clinoseraph.

Entry.JapaneseText: クロアセラフと同じく フローラ姉様の守護機士だった エース型機械人ですわ
Entry.EnglishText: Like Chlorseraph, he is an Ace model and one my sister's Mechaknights.

Entry.JapaneseText: ガルデニアが発動した時には サンドリオンにいたはずなのに なぜこんなところに……？
Entry.EnglishText: He was supposed to be aboard Cendrillon when Gardenia was activated, so what is he doing here?

Entry.JapaneseText: まさか…… 姉様が大切にしていた小鳥を 救おうとしたの？
Entry.EnglishText: You couldn't possibly... have come back to try and save the bird my sister loved so?

Entry.JapaneseText: 気をつけろよ、リチア。 クロアセラフの同類なんだろ？
Entry.EnglishText: Careful, Lithia. This guy's the same as Chorseraph, yeah?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……心配いりません。 機械人すら『白化』しています
Entry.EnglishText: ...There is no cause for concern. Even mechanoids aren;t immune to calcification.

Entry.JapaneseText: それに、かつてはリノもロアも フローラ姉様を慕う 優しい守護機士だったのです
Entry.EnglishText: Besides, both Clino and Chlor were once Fluora's beloved and kind Mechaknights.
...Master...Fluora...

Entry.JapaneseText: こいつ『白化』してないッ!?
Entry.EnglishText: He's not calcified?!

Entry.JapaneseText: 音声識別—— ガルデニア管理コア リチア＝スポデューン確認
Entry.EnglishText: identifying voice-Subject confirmed to be Gardenia's management core Lithia Spodune.

Entry.JapaneseText: リチアが『白化』した！ 何をしたの!?
Entry.EnglishText: She just calcified! What did you do to her?!
Master Fluora...

Entry.JapaneseText: 挙動解析。クリノセラフは リチア様の肉体からスピリアを 分離させる思念術を発動
Entry.EnglishText: Analyzing behavior. Clinoseraph has activated a Will Arte that has seperated Master Lithia's Spiria from her body.

Entry.JapaneseText: リチア様のスピリアは クリノセラフのスピルメイズに 捕獲されたと推測される
Entry.EnglishText: Her Spiria is presumed to be held captive within Clinoseraph's Spirmaze.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……解析結果否定！ 機械人のスピルメイズに スピルリンクなど不可能だ！
Entry.EnglishText: ...Analysis results negative! It is not possible to Spirlink with a mechanoid's Spiria!

Entry.JapaneseText: てめぇが言うか!? 可能かどうかやってみりゃ わかるぜ、<Shing>ッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Not with THAT attitude! Won't know 'till we try, right Shing?

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ、こいつに スピルリンクだ！
Entry.EnglishText: Yeah, time to Spirlink!

Entry.JapaneseText: 思念障壁多重展開。 スピルメイズからの リンクアウトを拒絶する
Entry.EnglishText: Deploying multiple Will barriers. It is now impossible to Link out.

Entry.JapaneseText: 計画通り ヤツらを封じたね、リノ
Entry.EnglishText: All locked up, just as we planned.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ああ。アクセスパスを入手し こいつらの思念力で ジャックシードを発動させる
Entry.EnglishText: ...Yes. Now to obtain the access pass and activate Jackseed using their captive Will.

Entry.JapaneseText: あったよ、アクセスパスだ。 これでリチアの体に用はないね
Entry.EnglishText: Here's the access pass. Now we no longer have any use for Lithia's body.

Entry.JapaneseText: ちっ、リノ！ しっかりスピルメイズに 閉じこめておけ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Tch! Dammit Lino, seal your Spirmaze properly!!

Entry.JapaneseText: 緑の刃物野郎…… てめぇも結晶界に落ちてやがったか
Entry.EnglishText: It's scissor-hands... so even you got flung all the way to Quartzia.

Entry.JapaneseText: 青の盾野郎を『白化』から 回復させたのはてめぇか？
Entry.EnglishText: Did you somehow save that blue freak from calcification?

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ。キミたちより先に『白化』 したリノを発見し、思念力を 分けて再起動しておいたんだ
Entry.EnglishText: That's right. I found a calcifyed Lino before you guys turned up, and split some of my Will power to reactivate him.
...I was dreaming the entire time.

Entry.JapaneseText: 『白化』の惨劇を二千年間—— 何万、何億回も繰り返し 夢に見続けた……
Entry.EnglishText: Reliving the tragedy of our world calcifying thwo thousand years ago, over and over...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……夢だと？ 否定。それはメモリに残された 信号にすぎない
Entry.EnglishText: ...Dream? Incorrect, that was merely signals based on your memory.

Entry.JapaneseText: そう、ただの信号さ。 けど、人間の夢や記憶…… スピリアも信号の集合体だ
Entry.EnglishText: Yeah, it's just signals. But human's dreams, memories... and even Spirias are but a collection of signals.

Entry.JapaneseText: 目覚めたリノは、夢の記憶で 擬似スピリアを再構築したんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Once Lino awoke, he was able to reconstruct the memory of his dream within his synthetic Spiria.

Entry.JapaneseText: 『白化』の元凶である リチアへの恨みに満ちた 悪夢のスピルメイズとしてね！
Entry.EnglishText: A Spirmaze built from a nightmare filled with resentment towards Lithia, the cause of the calcification!

Entry.JapaneseText: そんな場所に リチアを閉じこめたのか？
Entry.EnglishText: And you trapped her in such an awful place?

Entry.JapaneseText: 閉じこめただけではない。 俺のスピルメイズは『白化』の 瞬間をループ再現している
Entry.EnglishText: She is not trapped. My Spirmaze simply replays the moment the world calcified on loop.

Entry.JapaneseText: リチアには、あの恐怖と後悔の刻を 繰り返し味わってもらう。 スピリアが折れるまで何度でもな
Entry.EnglishText: Lithia will relive that fear and regret over and over. As many times it takes to break her Spiria.

Entry.JapaneseText: あああ…… いや！ いやッ!! もう、やめてぇぇーーーッ！！！
Entry.EnglishText: Ahh...no! Please, no more!!!

Entry.JapaneseText: クリノセラフ…… キサマ、なんという事を!!
Entry.EnglishText: Clinoseraph... how could you do such a thing?!

Entry.JapaneseText: フローラ様の忠告を無視し 結晶界を滅ぼした女には 当然の報いだ
Entry.EnglishText: It is a fitting reward for one who ignored my Master's warning and destroyed all of Quartzia.

Entry.JapaneseText: あははっ、僕も驚いたよ！ 盾代わりに使うつもりだった リノがこんなに役立つなんてね
Entry.EnglishText: Haha, I was shocked too! Who'd thought the guy made to just be a shield had all THIS up his sleeve!

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁ、リノ！ オマエは リチアのスピリアを破壊しろ！ 僕は体を斬り刻む!!
Entry.EnglishText: Go on, Lino! Crush her Spiria! Meanwhile I'LL dice up her body!

Entry.JapaneseText: 一緒に<Kunzite>の スピリアを解放しよう！
Entry.EnglishText: Let us free Kunzite's Spiria together!

Entry.JapaneseText: 断る。リチアのスピリアは フローラ様救出のために 使わせてもらう
Entry.EnglishText: I refuse. Lithia's Spiria will be used to save Master Fluora.

Entry.JapaneseText: リチアひとりでも スピリアをしぼりきれば 転送発動は可能だろう
Entry.EnglishText: Even Lithia alone should be enough to initiate a tranferral if we wring out her Spiria for all it is worth.

Entry.JapaneseText: フローラを救うだって……？ リノめ、バカな事をッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Save Fluora...? Lino, you idiot!!
Wait!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Kunzite>、リチアの スピリアでフローラを救うとは どういう意味だ？
Entry.EnglishText: Kunzite, what does he mean by using her Spiria to save Fluora?

Entry.JapaneseText: フローラ様は、ガルデニアの 中枢に封印されている。 おそらくクリノセラフは
Entry.EnglishText: Master Fluora is currently sealed within Gardenia. Clinoseraph most likely intends―

Entry.JapaneseText: ジャックシードを リチア様の思念力で発動させ ガルデニアへ飛ぶつもりなのだ
Entry.EnglishText: To use Master Lithia's Will to activate Jackseed and soar to Gardenia.

Entry.JapaneseText: やられた……！ アクセスパスを奪われてる
Entry.EnglishText: Damn! They took the access pass.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……リチアが過去の世界に 逃げなきゃこんな事に ならなかったのに……
Entry.EnglishText: ..This never would've happened if Lithia didn't go running off to the past...

Entry.JapaneseText: 逃げて何が悪い？ リチアは自分を生けにえにして ガルデニアを倒す気なんだぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: Can you blame her for runnin'? She's gonna sacrifice herself to stop Gardenia!

Entry.JapaneseText: しかも、寿命も ほとんど残ってねぇんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: Even worse, she's barely got any life left in her!

Entry.JapaneseText: 進む先は死だけ…… 怖くて当たり前だろ？
Entry.EnglishText: When the only way forward is to her death... Ain't it fair to be scared?

Entry.JapaneseText: 失くしたはずの懐かしい世界に 逃げたくなって当然じゃねぇか!? あいつは……あいつは……
Entry.EnglishText: Who WOULDN'T want to just run away to a world long gone?! She... she's...

Entry.JapaneseText: お兄ちゃん…… 生けにえって、本当なの？
Entry.EnglishText: Hisui... does she really intend to sacrifice herself?

Entry.JapaneseText: …………事実だ。 リチア様はガルデニアとの 融合術を完成された
Entry.EnglishText: ...Affirmative. Master Lithia can devised an Arte that will fuse herself with Gardenia.

Entry.JapaneseText: ご自分のスピリアを ガルデニアと融合し、自分自身を 吸引させ自壊消滅に導く——
Entry.EnglishText: Her Spiria will become one with Gardenia, leading it to absorb itself until reduced to nothingness.

Entry.JapaneseText: 覚醒したガルデニアを 倒す方法は、これ以外にはない
Entry.EnglishText: That is the only possible way to defeat Gardenia once it has awakened.

Entry.JapaneseText: そんな……私たちは リチアを生けにえにするために 戦ってたの……？
Entry.EnglishText: So... all this time we've been fighting... was for Lithia to sacrifice herself...?

Entry.JapaneseText: ごめぇん…… ボク知らなかったんだよぉ……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm sorry... I had no idea...

Entry.JapaneseText: <Kunzite>…… ジャックシードは どこにあるんだ？
Entry.EnglishText: Kunzite... Where's Jackseed?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ワンダリデル南西。 ラトウィックの森を抜けた先だ
Entry.EnglishText: ...Southwest of Wonderidell. Beyond Lutwidge Forest.

Entry.JapaneseText: わかった、急ごう。 それから……
Entry.EnglishText: Okay. Let's hurry. Then...

Entry.JapaneseText: リチアを取り戻したら あいつを一発ひっぱたくけど とめるなよ！
Entry.EnglishText: Once we get her back, I'll slap some sense into her!

Entry.JapaneseText: わたしもだよ！ そんなつらい想いを ひとりで抱えてたなんて許せない!!
Entry.EnglishText: Me too! She's in a world of trouble from hiding all this pain from me!
Count me in, too!

Entry.JapaneseText: ボクも！ ……謝ってから、しっぺだ
Entry.EnglishText: Me three! Though... I'll be sure to say sorry afterwards.

Entry.JapaneseText: …………認められない。 自分はリチア様の 守護機士として……
Entry.EnglishText: ...I cannot allow this. As Master Lithia's Mechaknight...

Entry.JapaneseText: ボヤボヤするな、<Kunzite>！ リチアの体を忘れんなよ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Quit dawdlin', Kunzite! Make sure to bring her body with you!

Entry.JapaneseText: リチアのスピリアは クリノセラフのスピルメイズに 捕獲されたようだ
Entry.EnglishText: Lithia's Spiria is completely captured in Chrinoseraph's Spirmaze.
There's a birdcage, but it's empty...
